{{Quote|There&mdash;a break in the Sith formations! Green squadron, move in!|Admiral Forn Dodonna|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
'''Green Squadron''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] equipped with [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|''Aurek''-class tactical strikefighters]] and [[S-250 Chela-class starfighter|S-250 ''Chela''-class starfighters]].<ref name="KotOR" />

In the [[3956 BBY]] [[Battle of Rakata Prime]] of the [[Jedi Civil War]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> this unit flew with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Forn Dodonna]]'s strike force against [[Darth Malak]]'s [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. Noticing a break in the enemy formations, Dodonna ordered the squadron to move in, breaking through the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] lines&mdash;followed into the breach by [[Red Wing (Old Republic)|Red Squadron]]. Their position reinforced by [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|capital ships]], the Republic forces struck at the [[Star Forge]] itself, destroying the ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] and ending the battle.<ref name="KotOR" />
